purpose: Recover the compact initial-scene palette/VRAM helper entry points omitted from the sparse Ghidra function body.

shared_body.name: SceneResource_CopyWordsToInitialC000
shared_body.contract: Uses D0 as a DBF count, writes the VDP C000 command, copies words from A0 to VDP_DATA, restores the caller's D0, and returns.

boundary_basis: Each entry begins at an instruction-aligned prologue and ends immediately before the shared 0x001B2624 word-copy body.
The source-pointer publications and DBF counts establish four, three, and one 16-word source variants exactly.
No direct producer is claimed for any of the compact variants.
